NVDA.text: Nvidia fell 1.6% in the regular session as investors stayed cautious ahead of its after-hours earnings report and a hotter inflation reading; no separate pre-close Nvidia-specific catalyst was confirmed.

AVGO.text: Broadcom fell 0.3% in subdued semiconductor trading as investors awaited Nvidia earnings after a hotter inflation reading; no fresh Broadcom-specific catalyst was confirmed.

TSM.text: TSM edged up 0.1% in cautious semiconductor trading ahead of Nvidia earnings, with no fresh TSM-specific catalyst confirmed.

ASML.text: ASML edged up 0.1% in subdued semiconductor trading ahead of Nvidia earnings, with no fresh ASML-specific catalyst confirmed.

KLAC.text: KLA rose 0.3% in modest semiconductor trading ahead of Nvidia earnings, with no fresh KLA-specific catalyst confirmed.

INTC.text: Intel rose 0.9% as chip shares held relatively firm ahead of Nvidia earnings despite a hotter inflation reading; no fresh Intel-specific catalyst was confirmed.

MU.text: Micron rose 0.6% in the broader semiconductor trade ahead of Nvidia earnings, with no fresh Micron-specific catalyst confirmed.

TSLA.text: Tesla fell 1.3% in ordinary trading as the broader market finished roughly flat to slightly lower, with no confirmed fresh Tesla-specific catalyst strong enough to explain the move.

META.text: Meta rose 1.1% after agreeing to a multibillion-dollar settlement with U.S. states over youth social-media claims, reducing a major litigation overhang without requiring fundamental changes to its business model.

PLTR.text: Palantir rose 2.8% with no fresh company-specific catalyst conclusively confirmed; the move extended its strong post-earnings momentum while the broader market finished roughly flat.

SPCX.text: SpaceX rose 1.2% after announcing plans for a $100 billion Starbase campus in Louisiana, extending the stock's rebound as investors assessed the scale of the company's planned launch expansion.
